title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and former Orzhov leader who discovers Zegana's body and helps Proft hunt the killer.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The head of the Orzhov Syndicate and host of the gala, who orders the locked door broken and locks down the manor.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: A massive archon and chief of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations, who stands guard at the crime scene.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros warleader who insists the guilds, not the Agency, handle the investigation.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: The leader of the Simic Combine, devastated by Zegana's murder.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A Simic figure found dead, posed on a pile of coats with a black iris in her hand.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young Agency investigator who catches the fleeing Etrata.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A graying human detective in an azure coat who deduces the guild-seal pattern and exposes the Dimir agent; his magic recreates anything he has seen.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A vampire Dimir agent and known assassin disguised in Selesnya colors, who flees when Proft confronts her.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: The Azorius Grand Arbiter who orders Etrata remanded to Azorius custody.

entities.name: Larysa
entities.description: A household member sent to find the key to the locked room.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A Rakdos figure who vanished before the killing.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city-plane where the investigation takes place.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: Teysa's manor, where the murder occurs and which is locked down.

entities.name: Hedge maze
entities.description: A maze on the manor grounds Etrata tries to reach.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild hosting the gala.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The guild of Zegana and Vannifar.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law guild whose lawmages cast verity circles.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild that enforces the law and assists the Azorius.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: A detective body led by Ezrim and sidelined by the guilds.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The guild of spies whose seal is hidden in the pattern.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A guild whose colors Etrata wore as a disguise.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: An absent guild whose seal appears in the pattern.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A guild with few representatives at the gala.

entities.name: Verity circle
entities.description: An Azorius spell that compels truthful answers though it cannot compel speech.

events.summary: Kaya and Teysa race through the manor toward the scream and find a locked door.
events.quote: Kaya ran through the manor as swiftly as her legs could carry her.

events.summary: Servers report the door is locked and the key is missing; the door is warded against ghosts.
events.quote: The door's locked, ma'am

events.summary: At Ezrim's urging, Teysa orders the door broken and it is smashed open.
events.quote: Two heavy blows and the door snapped off its hinges, breaking clean in two as it fell inward.

events.summary: Kaya enters, gasps, and asks Teysa to send for Vannifar.
events.quote: All of them heard Kaya's quickly cut-off gasp, followed by frozen silence.

events.summary: Teysa and Kaya find Zegana dead, posed on a pile of coats in the cloakroom.
events.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine was artfully arranged at the center of the pile.

events.summary: Kaya notices a black iris petal in Zegana's fingers, though none was used in the decor.
events.quote: Kaya saw the edges of a flower petal protruding from between Zegana's fingers.

events.summary: Aurelia reports that Ezrim's people are locking down the building.
events.quote: Vannifar is coming, and Ezrim's people are locking down the building.

events.summary: Teysa informs Vannifar of Zegana's death.
events.quote: it is with the deepest of regrets that I inform you that Zegana of the Simic Combine has been killed.

events.summary: Aurelia declares the Legion will take over the investigation while Agency detectives argue.
events.quote: The Legion will take over from here.

events.summary: Azorius senators set up verity circles to question all guests.
events.quote: They had cast their spells with admirable speed

events.summary: Kaya realizes Judith, the Rakdos guest, vanished before the killing.
events.quote: Judith, who had vanished before the killing.

events.summary: The Agency and Azorius search the sealed crime scene.
events.quote: Barrier wards had been deployed inside the scene

events.summary: Kaya and Aurelia are questioned in a verity circle and Kaya withholds Judith's name.
events.quote: Had either of them killed her? No.

events.summary: Alquist Proft enters the crime scene and introduces himself as the great detective.
events.quote: I'm Alquist Proft.

events.summary: Proft deduces that Zegana was posed so the guild seals form a pattern.
events.quote: she has been arranged such that the sign of each guild is visible on the coats beneath her, and a pattern has been formed.

events.summary: Proft shows the pattern includes all ten seals and says a Dimir member is in attendance.
events.quote: You've also failed to spot the one member of House Dimir in attendance.

events.summary: Proft explains he spotted a guest avoiding Selesnya members while wearing Selesnya colors.
events.quote: I might not have seen her, had she not been taking such exquisite care to avoid interaction with members of the Selesnya Conclave.

events.summary: Proft confronts Etrata, who bares vampire fangs and flees toward the hedge maze.
events.quote: Charging straight for Proft, she knocked the investigator to the ground and began to cut a straight line through the crowd, heading for the hedge maze.

events.summary: Proft's magic transforms the courtyard into an Orzhov alley, slowing Etrata.
events.quote: the world abruptly inverted itself around her

events.summary: The illusion ends as Etrata runs into Kellan, who restrains her.
events.quote: Etrata plowed directly into Kellan.

events.summary: Proft explains that his magic recreates anything he has seen.
events.quote: I make what's in here become out there, and I can recreate anything I've ever seen

events.summary: Proft persuades Kellan not to fight the Azorius over the suspect.
events.quote: This is not the time to stand our ground

events.summary: Lavinia demands that the suspect be remanded to Azorius custody and Etrata is taken away.
events.quote: Remand the suspect to Azorius custody at once

relations.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine was artfully arranged at the center of the pile.
Find me one of my detectives. The Agency should be represented here.
Warleader, with the exception of the people in this room
Even Grand Arbiter Lavinia has allowed herself to be interrogated.
The young Agency investigator looked surprised

relations.note: speaks of the Agency as his own
relations.quote: The Agency doesn't need the glory if we can have the satisfaction of knowing that without us, none of this would have been possible.
even with clasped arms around the runaway Dimir

relations.note: Kellan thanks him for helping apprehend Etrata
relations.quote: Thank you for helping us apprehend this miscreant.

relations.note: glare at each other over jurisdiction
relations.quote: The archon was standing, wings half-mantled, as he glared at Aurelia.
